title: Log in with valid credentials and reach protected areas
description: Verifies that a customer can sign in with the hardcoded account and then access protected order history and admin pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the order history navigation link
Verify order history is displayed
Click the admin navigation link
Verify the admin page is displayed

title: Block order history before signing in
description: An unauthenticated visitor is prevented from viewing order history and is shown the sign-in gate instead.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the sign-in gate is displayed
Verify order history content is not displayed

title: Browse product catalog cards and open a product detail page
description: Verifies that a visitor can browse products on the catalog and open a selected product's details with the expected information visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify product cards are displayed
Click the details action for a product
Verify the selected product's details are displayed

title: Log out and lose access to protected pages
description: Verifies that a signed-in user can log out and protected pages are blocked again afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the logout action
Click the order history navigation link
Verify protected access is blocked again
Click the admin navigation link
Verify protected access is blocked again

title: Protect order history after logout
description: A user who logs out can no longer access the protected order history page and is shown the sign-in gate again.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /orders
Log out of the authenticated session
Navigate to /orders
Verify the sign-in gate is displayed
Verify order history content is not displayed

title: Protect the admin area after logout
description: A user who logs out can no longer access the protected admin page and is shown the sign-in gate again.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Log out of the authenticated session
Navigate to /admin
Verify the sign-in gate is displayed
Verify admin content is not displayed

title: View order history after signing in
description: Verifies that a customer can sign in and see order history cards with product, price, and date information.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the order history navigation link
Verify order cards are displayed
Verify product, price, and date information are displayed

title: View past orders after signing in
description: An authenticated user can open the order history page and see past purchase cards with product, price, and date information.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /orders
Verify order cards are displayed
Verify each order card shows product, price, and date information

title: Buy a product from its detail page after signing in
description: Verifies that a signed-in user can open a product detail page and receive purchase success feedback after buying.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the details action for a product
Click the buy action for the product
Verify a purchase success confirmation is visible

title: View complete product information on a product detail page
description: Verifies that a selected product page shows the image, category, price, and description that shoppers need before buying.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the details action for a product
Verify the product image is displayed
Verify the product category, price, and description are displayed

title: Add a product in the admin area
description: An authenticated admin can create a new product and see it appear in the managed product list with a confirmation message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Fill in the product name field with Test Product Alpha
Fill in the product price field with 19.99
Fill in the product category field with Accessories
Fill in the product description field with A newly added test product
Submit the product form
Verify the new product appears in the managed list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Edit an existing product in the admin area
description: An authenticated admin can update an existing product and see the managed list reflect the edited details with a confirmation message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Choose an existing product to edit
Update the product name field with Test Product Beta
Update the product price field with 24.99
Save the changes
Verify the edited product details are shown in the managed list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Add, edit, and delete a product in the admin page
description: Verifies that an admin can create a product, update it, delete it, and see the product list and snackbar feedback update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin navigation link
Add a new product
Verify the new product appears in the admin list
Edit the newly added product
Verify the updated product appears in the admin list
Delete the updated product
Verify the product is removed from the admin list
Verify snackbar feedback is visible

title: Delete a product in the admin area
description: An authenticated admin can remove an existing product and see it disappear from the managed list with a confirmation message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin
Choose an existing product to delete
Delete the selected product
Verify the product is removed from the managed list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: See buying unavailable before signing in
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot complete a purchase from the catalog and is shown that sign-in is required.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the buy action for a product
Verify purchasing is unavailable until sign-in
Verify the user remains on the catalog page

title: Show login validation feedback for incorrect credentials
description: Verifies that entering invalid credentials keeps the user on the login page and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with invalid@example.com
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify a login validation error is visible
Verify the login page is still displayed

title: Keep admin product form validation for empty fields
description: Verifies that the admin product form shows validation feedback and does not create a product when required fields are left empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the admin navigation link
Attempt to submit the product form without filling required fields
Verify product form validation errors are visible
Verify no new product is added to the admin list

title: Show login validation for missing credentials
description: Submitting the login form with incomplete credentials shows validation feedback and does not sign the user in.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Submit the login form
Verify a login validation error is visible
Verify the authenticated session is not established
